name: draftio-image
description: Pick the right image model, write the prompt, and quote the exact point price before generating on the Draftio canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Choose a model, write the prompt, quote the price.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Draftio image workflow: read live per-model prices, choose between 16 image models, write a prompt matched to the model's dialect, and quote the exact point cost before the user generates on the Draftio canvas.
